headline: OpenAI says it has formed a strategic partnership with JPMorganChase
body: OpenAI co-founder and president Greg Brockman said on Wednesday (Nov. 4) that the company has formed a strategic partnership with JPMorganChase to supply the bank with AI services, The Wall Street Journal reported. Under the partnership, the bank gets access to cybersecurity-focused models through OpenAI's Daybreak program.
note: The first use named is cybersecurity. Brockman says the companies will also explore how AI can help engineers, security teams, employees and customers.

evidence.text: OpenAI Co-Founder and President Greg Brockman said Wednesday (Nov. 4) that the company could be ready for an initial public offering in 2027 and that it has formed a strategic partnership with JPMorganChase to supply the bank with artificial intelligence services, The Wall Street Journal reported
As part of the partnership with JPMorganChase, OpenAI will provide the bank with access to cybersecurity-focused models as part of the AI company’s Daybreak program, the report said.

After the event, Brockman said in a post on X that in the partnership with JPMorganChase, the companies will explore how advanced AI can support the bank by helping engineers, security teams, employees and customers.
